question: Where has the 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA 2025 taken place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA 2025 will take place off Chennai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 14th edition of the India-Russia bilateral naval exercise INDRA will be held from 28 March to 2 April 2025 off Chennai.**
 
• The exercise will be conducted in two phases: Harbour phase (28 to 30 March) and Sea phase (31 March to 2 April).
 
• The exercise will feature naval ships from both nations, including Russian Federation Naval Ships Pechanga, Rezkiy, and Aldar Tsydenzhapov, and Indian Naval Ships Rana and Kuthar.
 
• The exercise aims to enhance maritime cooperation, exchange best operational practices, and strengthen diplomatic ties between India and Russia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INDRA Exercise Background__

 __
 
• INDRA has been conducted since 2003 and epitomizes the long-term strategic relationship between the Indian and Russian Navies.
 
• The exercise has evolved into a symbol of maritime cooperation between both countries.
 
 
 
• Activities during the Harbour and Sea Phases__
 
 
• Harbour Phase includes SMEEs, reciprocal visits, sports fixtures, and pre-sail briefings.
 
• The Sea Phase features advanced naval drills, tactical manoeuvres, live weapon firings, anti-air operations, and helicopter cross-deck landings.
